# Pragmatic @ Stage 11 — Abstract Emerge

> developed 2026-07-24.

## Crosswalk (from unified ladder)

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| IST Stage# | 11 |
| Canonical name | Abstract Emerge |
| Altitude | `orange` (Worldcentric emerging) |
| MHC Order | 10 (Abstract) |
| Kegan | 3→4 |
| Identity band | Worldcentric emerging |

## Expression on this line

Pragmatic capacity at Order 10 is practical mastery: expert-level problem-solving that
operates beyond conscious rule-following, producing solutions that transcend inherited
methods. The expert practitioner who can improvise within established methods, innovate
beyond them, and teach others to do the same.

## Integrity markers (healthy inclusion)

- **UL:** the felt fluency of expert practical reasoning.\n- **UR:** the capacity to innovate within and beyond inherited methods.\n- **LL:** a practical culture that values mastery and innovation.\n- **LR:** the institutional structures that support practical mastery.

## Pathology markers (Agape / Eros)

- **Dark addiction:** mastery as ego.\n- **Dark allergy:** mastery absence.\n- **Golden addiction:** claiming to have achieved formal practical modeling (Stage 12)\n- **Golden allergy:** refusing to engage with practical mastery.

## Diagnostic cues (Gross / Ground R&D)

- **Expert-level problem-solving:** the individual demonstrates mastery beyond conscious
  rule-following.\n- **Practical innovation:** the individual produces genuinely new solutions.\n- **Teaching capacity:** the master can transmit their practical expertise.

## Sources, joints, open questions

**Sources:** Dreyfus & Dreyfus, *Mind over Machine* (expert skill as post-rule-following);
Schön, *The Reflective Practitioner* (expert practical reasoning).\n**Open joints:** How does practical mastery shade into formal practical modeling (Stage 12)?
**Research debt:** pairs with `10-concrete-peak` (complex practical integration) and
`12-formal-landmark` (formal practical modeling).
